title: Mouse genes with lipid-related phenotypes
bodyHtml:
This table lists the human homologs of mouse genes whose loss of function causes lipid-related mutant phenotypes. This list was used as a "silver standard" set in evaluating gene prioritization methods for plasma lipid levels in this study:

Implicating genes, pleiotropy, and sexual dimorphism at blood lipid loci through multi-ancestry meta-analysis.
Kanoni S, Graham SE, Wang Y, Surakka I, Ramdas S, Zhu X, et al.
Genome Biol. 2022 Dec 27;23(1):268. doi: 10.1186/s13059-022-02837-1.
PMID: 36575460

See the "Research Method" tab for details.
